raw_text: Punjab se taza tasveereen. Har jagah se kisan aa rahe hain. Ye photos dekhke lagta hai poora Hindustan uth khada hua hai. GT Road pe jahan tak nazar jaati hai tractors hi tractors hain. Sarkar ne barricade lagaye par log rok nahi paa rahe.
clean_text: Photos from Punjab showing farmers arriving from everywhere. Claims of tractors filling GT Road as far as the eye can see despite barricades.
